<infobox theme="Music">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="composer"><label>Composer</label></data>	
        <data source="written"><label>Written</label></data>
        <data source="recorded"><label>Recorded</label></data>
        <data source="release date"><label>Released</label></data>
        <data source="represents"><label>Represents</label></data>
        <data source="performedby"><label>Performed by</label></data>
        <data source="genre"><label>Genre</label></data>				
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Musical details</header>
        <data source="length"><label>Length</label></data>	
        <data source="key"><label>[[wikipedia:Key (music)|Key]]</label></data>
        <data source="tempo"><label>[[Wikipedia:Tempo|Tempo]]/Style</label></data>
        <data source="texture"><label>[[Wikipedia:Texture (music)|Texture]]</label></data>
        <data source="timesig"><label>[[Wikipedia:Time signature|Time signature]]</label></data>
        <data source="meter"><label>[[Wikipedia:Meter (music)|Meter]]</label></data>
        <data source="mode"><label>[[Wikipedia:Mode (music)|Mode]]</label></data>
        <data source="lyrics"><label>[[wikipedia:Lyrics|Lyrics]]</label></data>				
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Usage information</header>
        <data source="soundtracks"><label>Soundtracks</label></data>	
        <data source="movies"><label>Movies</label></data>
        <data source="EU"><label>Legends</label></data>
        <data source="canon"><label>Canon</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Samples</header>  
        <data source="media"><label>Versions</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Music|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
